name: How do you remove smoke odor from a kitchen after a fire?

mainEntity.name: How do you remove smoke odor from a kitchen after a fire?

acceptedAnswer.text: Removing smoke odor from a kitchen after a fire requires specialized techniques beyond simple cleaning. Professionals first remove all smoke-damaged items and clean all surfaces to eliminate embedded soot particles. Then, they employ advanced odor neutralization methods such as thermal fogging, ozone treatment, hydroxyl generators, or air scrubbers. These methods penetrate porous materials to break down smoke molecules at a molecular level, rather than just masking the smell. Proper ventilation and air filtration are also crucial throughout the process to ensure complete odor elimination.
acceptedAnswer.description: Professionals remove smoke-damaged items and use specialized techniques like thermal fogging, ozone treatment, and hydroxyl generators to break down smoke molecules and eliminate odors.
